challenges.challenge: Can a collective recurrence omit an interaction or lose a molecular identity?
challenges.resolution: Collective binds the full constituent projection and action-row projection to original carrier/interaction lists, then binds their concatenated actions to the existing closed recurrence. appendEdges/appendConnectivity preserve the exact generated successor.

challenges.challenge: Is release merely asserted, or can the complete original assembly be reconstructed?
challenges.resolution: release and reconstruct are explicit inverse record operations on full carriers and channels; both compositions are proved. Whole retains each admitted internal molecule, all recognition rows and the collective recurrence. The original minimum size proves the whole support differs from any singleton.
